changes.title: Product-context preservation into RFQ and sample forms
changes.description: contact.html's existing URL-param prefill script now falls back to selecting 'Other / Multiple Products' and writing the exact product name into the requirements textarea when no dropdown option matches (true for most of the 84 specific SKUs); sample-request.js now prefills the specification textarea from a ?product= param without forcing a category-button guess; all 84 English + 840 locale product-page CTAs now pass ?product=<name> to contact.html and sample-request.html.

changes.title: RTL breadcrumb chevron direction

remaining_findings.type: operational, not a site content defect
remaining_findings.summary: audit_coverage_gaps.py has no exclusion rule for .cloudflare-dist-next or other build-output directories; if such a directory is left on disk when the script runs, it double-counts the site and reports orphan_indexable_page false positives for every page inside the build mirror.
remaining_findings.action_taken: deleted the stale gitignored build artifact and re-confirmed 0 findings; did not modify the audit script itself, since this is a pre-existing script assumption unrelated to any Phase 11 change
remaining_findings.recommendation_for_future_phases: delete .cloudflare-dist-next (or equivalent) before running audit_coverage_gaps.py, or add a directory exclusion to that script in a future phase if this keeps recurring

remaining_findings.summary: contact.html's product dropdown covers ~20 of 84 products by name; the remaining ~64 rely on the new free-text fallback
remaining_findings.recommendation: expand the dropdown only if real lead data shows sales-team friction from the fallback path
